illustration_style: Hand-painted botanical gouache with an original romantic cottagecore editorial sensibility; refined, decorative botanical illustration rather than photography or scientific plate reproduction.
line_weight: Fine, restrained warm brown-charcoal ink outlines with occasional delicate interior contouring.
line_quality: Graceful, slightly organic hand-drawn lines; clean enough for premium digital print, never sketchy or scratchy.
detail_level: Moderately detailed layered botanical forms, with detail concentrated in petals, foliage, stems and small decorative flourishes; generous unpainted space preserves a calm premium finish.
background_density: Airy cream-paper grounds with sparse botanical accents, faint tonal washes and occasional understated framing devices; backgrounds always recede behind titles and practical information.
composition: Elegant editorial hierarchy with one clear botanical focal area, balanced vertical flow, ample calm space for legible titles or instructions, and delicate dividers used sparingly.
palette: Warm cream foundation with soft blush, muted rose, dusty sage, gentle lavender and small powder-blue accents, anchored by warm brown-charcoal typography; low-saturation colours with harmonious dusk-like contrast.
shading: Soft gouache layering, gentle tonal gradients and subtle cool-to-warm shadowing; no hard digital highlights, heavy contrast or glossy effects.
texture: Visible but delicate cold-press paper grain, dry-brush edges and softly varied opaque gouache pigment, retained subtly for reliable home printing.
mood: Poetic, romantic, tranquil and heirloom-inspired, with a quietly enchanted botanical atmosphere.
print_considerations: Portrait digital pages designed for home printing on A4 or US Letter; retain a light cream ground and restrained coverage to avoid excessive ink use, use high-contrast warm charcoal text, and keep fine decorative lines clear at typical home-printer resolution.
shared_prompt: Original hand-painted botanical gouache for a premium romantic cottagecore crochet-pattern bundle, on softly textured warm cream paper. Use elegant layered floral and foliage forms, fine organic warm brown-charcoal ink outlines, restrained editorial detail, delicate dry-brush texture and gentle natural gouache shading. Palette: soft blush, muted rose, dusty sage, lavender and small powder-blue accents, with warm charcoal typography. Airy, refined, poetic and quietly moonlit; full-colour printable design with generous space and crisp legibility, never photographic.
avoid: Photography, photorealism or realistic product mock-ups
Copied vintage botanical plates, identifiable layouts or derivative branded artwork
Crochet hooks, yarn balls, stitch diagrams or finished crochet objects within the decorative illustrations
Harsh neon colours, glossy digital gradients or heavy black shadows
Crowded page layouts, excessive ink coverage or unreadably fine details
Misspelled text, illegible decorative lettering or low-contrast typography
